resources.string: A simple playground for cached_flow and extension scenarios
Initialization uses SharedPreferenceStore and DemoLogger, which also forwards messages to AndroidLogger.
These buttons run the same fake request with a String key so you can compare IF_HAVE, ONLY_REQUEST, and ONLY_CACHE.
Save response to cache after request (cachedAfterLoad=true)
Each button performs a round trip: write via ONLY_REQUEST and read via ONLY_CACHE. This covers all built-in key classes, including the Byte, Short, Char, and Double adapters.
This section tests serializableKey, serializableListKey, a custom SerializersModule, and behavior with legacy or malformed JSON.
The top block shows a raw SharedPreferences dump, and the bottom block shows a combined demo and library event log.
